headline: Sensex surges over 1,000 points and Nifty tops 25,300 as market opens strongly

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing Iran tensions and lower crude oil prices boosted market sentiment.
Bernstein hiked its Nifty 50 target to 26,100, highlighting financials as the most attractive sector.
Positive global cues and geopolitical developments fueled strong buying across all 30 Sensex stocks.
Strong pre-open momentum drove Sensex up over 900 to 1,100 points.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped over 1,000 points and Nifty crossed the 25,300 level at market open.
MSCI November rejig speculation put Coforge, LIC, and Adani Green among expected additions.
Individual ownership in NSE-listed firms reached a record high of 19.5% in Q2FY27.
Top market gainers in early trading included IndiGo, Mahindra & Mahindra, and Asian Paints.
summary: Indian equities posted sharp gains at open on November 11 as Sensex surged over 1,000 points and Nifty comfortably cleared 25,300. The rally was backed by easing Iran tensions, reduced oil price pressures, and bullish forecasts from Bernstein. Key stocks in the spotlight included top gainers IndiGo, M&M, and Asian Paints, alongside MSCI rejig candidates.
